pair_calibration.basis: maximum likelihood on earlier seasons' out-of-sample predictions
pair_calibration.split_basis: nhl_split_ml_v1 promoted 2026-10-29: b fitted on the moneyline of every earlier out-of-sample game (hockey/model/split_shadow.js)

model.basis: eta = log expected regulation goals of the goalie-aware variant with its goalie term at zero; a pairing prices as exp(eta + goalie_beta × the opposing goalie's rating), pair-calibrated, through hockey/model/distribution.js

all_pair_calibration.basis: maximum likelihood on earlier seasons' out-of-sample predictions
all_pair_calibration.split_basis: nhl_split_ml_v1 promoted 2026-10-29: b fitted on the moneyline of every earlier out-of-sample game (hockey/model/split_shadow.js)

model.all_basis: at lineup lock: exp(lineup.eta + all_beta.goalie × the opposing goalie's rating + all_beta.lu_own × ln(own lineup value / own typical) + all_beta.lu_opp × the same for the opponent), pair-calibrated; a lineup value is the sum of skater_values over the dressed skaters (hockey/model/lineups.js)

ratings.basis: hockey/model/ratings.js goalieRating: goals saved above expected per xG faced, decayed with the half-life and shrunk toward the replacement-level prior (the v1 rating; unchanged)
